body.name: Guarded arithmetic circuit
body.construction: A circuit is a finite list \(F=((g_b,F_b))_{b=1}^m\) in which each \(g_b\) is a guard, each \(F_b\) is an arithmetic DAG over rational constants and cells \(p(a)\) using \(+,-,\times,/\) and finite sums, the guards cover \(\Omega_H\), every divisor is strictly positive on its branch domain, and \(F_b(p)=F_{b'}(p)\) whenever \(p\in\Omega_H\) satisfies both \(g_b\) and \(g_{b'}\). For \(p\in\Omega_H\), \(\operatorname{Eval}(F,p)\) is this common value for any satisfied guard, so evaluation is total and independent of branch choice even when guards overlap.
